extension.description: Strem4Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news: 1.8.6: restored styled search keyboard with movie/series autocomplete and recent history; native hidden Kodi input for API keys; unclipped catalogue menus; UK age badges; audio, quality and reported P7 FEL filters; structured stream metadata; live feeds open without an extra range probe; BetterPosters artwork and consolidated duplicate catalogues.
